about.description: The Sloop Galley and Spirits is a locals eatery and watering hole in Gulf Shores featuring fresh quality foods made in house and exceptional service. Known for original Philly cheesesteaks and homemade items with a pirate dive bar atmosphere.

menu.name: Sloop Du Jour
menu.description: please inquire about the rotating daily soup, thoughtfully prepared by the captain. don't forget the toast points for an additional $2

menu.name: Cheesesteak Egg Rolls
menu.description: choice of chicken or steak with cherry peppers, cheese whiz, and sloop slaw, hand rolled to order, fried golden brown, served with hot honey mustard

menu.name: Wings
menu.description: one pound of house brined wings, fried and tossed in buffalo, bbq, or have them naked, served with carrot sticks, celery, and choice of ranch or bleu cheese

menu.name: Sizzlin Shrimp
menu.description: one dozen gulf shrimp sautéed in garlic butter, lemon, capers, grape tomatoes, red onions, and sriracha, served with toast points

menu.name: Baked Stuffed Shrooms
menu.description: philly cream cheese with sausage, stuffed in button mushrooms, baked with chablis, roasted garlic, parmesan cheese, and green onions, served with toast points

menu.name: Nachos
menu.description: choice of steak, chicken or shrimp (+$2) double layered on tortillas with cheddar jack cheese, diced red onions, tomatoes, roasted poblano peppers, and queso, served with homemade guacamole, salsa and sour cream

menu.name: Chips and Salsa
menu.description: fried to order tortilla chips, and house made so fresh salsa

menu.name: Boat O' Fries
menu.description: house cut to order kennebec potatoes fried golden and crispy

menu.name: Basket O' Chips
menu.description: large order of house sliced kennebec

specials.name: Daily Specials
specials.description: View our daily specials on Facebook
